intro: Jakarta rewards visitors who embrace its energy, from street food to colonial relics. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: Jakarta MRT runs Lebak Bulus to Bundaran HI, every 5-10 min, 05:00-midnight.
TransJakarta BRT has 14 mainlines on dedicated lanes; fares Rp2,000-20,000 with one card.
KAI Commuter trains link suburbs and run 04:30-midnight; Jabodebek and Jakarta LRT cover more areas.
Grab and Gojek are the main ride apps; metered taxis exist but agree on price or use the meter.
Driving is slow and congested; odd-even plate rules apply on some toll roads on weekdays.
Walking long distances is impractical; use apps or transit between areas.

monas.name: Monas (National Monument)
monas.price_text: Around IDR 20,000 for the top; grounds free. Check on the day.
monas.hours: Grounds roughly 08:00–22:00; monument tower hours vary, often closed Monday
monas.tip: Go early morning to beat heat and queues, and ride the lift to the top for a city view.

istiqlal.name: Istiqlal Mosque
istiqlal.hours: Open outside prayer times; non-Muslim visitors usually guided. Check on the day.
istiqlal.tip: Dress modestly and ask a guide at the entrance; the mosque faces Monas across the street.

kota-tua.name: Kota Tua Jakarta (Old Town)
kota-tua.price_text: Square free; some museums charge small fees
kota-tua.hours: Square always open; museums roughly 09:00–15:00, closed Monday
kota-tua.tip: Rent a colourful vintage bike in the square and visit the old Dutch buildings in the morning.

ancol.name: Ancol Dreamland
ancol.price_text: Park entry fee plus per-attraction tickets; check on the day
ancol.tip: It is a big seaside park with beaches and rides; buy tickets per attraction and go on a weekday.

dufan.name: Dunia Fantasy (Dufan)
dufan.price_text: One-day pass; price varies by day. Check on the day.
dufan.tip: Inside Ancol. Arrive at opening and ride the big coasters before queues build.

gbk.name: Gelora Bung Karno Stadium
gbk.price_text: Free to walk the park; event tickets vary
gbk.hours: Park open daily; stadium only for events or tours
gbk.tip: The surrounding sports park is great for a morning jog or bike ride even without a match.

kidzania.name: Kidzania Jakarta
kidzania.price_text: Timed tickets; check on the day
kidzania.tip: Book online for a morning slot; it is best for kids roughly 4–12.

moi.name: Mall of Indonesia
moi.price_text: Free to enter; pay per shop
moi.tip: A huge mall in North Jakarta; good for air-conditioned shopping and food on a hot afternoon.

nasi-goreng.name: Nasi Goreng (fried rice)
nasi-goreng.price_text: Street stalls around IDR 15,000–35,000; restaurants more
nasi-goreng.hours: Street stalls often evening to late night
nasi-goreng.tip: Try a street warung or night market stall; ask for it 'pedas' if you like spicy.

national-museum.name: National Museum of Indonesia
national-museum.price_text: Small entry fee; check on the day
national-museum.tip: See the old stone statues and the treasure room; go in the morning when it is cool.

mekarsari.name: Taman Buah Mekarsari
mekarsari.price_text: Entry plus activity tickets; check on the day
mekarsari.tip: A fruit orchard park outside the city centre; plan a half day and bring sun protection.

tmii.name: Taman Mini Indonesia Indah
tmii.price_text: Park entry plus per-pavilion tickets; check on the day
tmii.tip: A big cultural park with houses from across Indonesia; use the shuttle or rent a bike.

trans-studio.name: Trans Studio Cibubur
trans-studio.price_text: Day pass; check on the day
trans-studio.tip: An indoor theme park on the city edge; good for a rainy day with kids.

snow-world.name: Transpark Snow World
snow-world.price_text: Timed tickets; check on the day
snow-world.tip: An indoor snow play area; wear the warm clothes they provide and book a slot.

world-of-wanders.name: World of Wanders Theme Park
world-of-wanders.price_text: Ticket prices vary; check on the day
world-of-wanders.tip: Confirm opening hours and tickets before you go, as new parks change schedules.

glodok-market.name: Glodok Market (Chinatown)
glodok-market.price_text: Free to walk; pay per stall
glodok-market.tip: Wander the narrow lanes near Kota Tua for snacks and old shops; go in the morning.

sunda-kelapa-walk.name: Sunda Kelapa old harbour walk
sunda-kelapa-walk.price_text: Free to walk; boat trips cost extra
sunda-kelapa-walk.tip: See the wooden pinisi sailing ships; a short walk from Kota Tua, best in the morning.

kemang-walk.name: Kemang neighbourhood walk
kemang-walk.price_text: Free to walk; pay per cafe
kemang-walk.tip: A leafy area of cafes, bars and small shops; good for an evening stroll and dinner.

night-market-food-tour.name: Evening street-food tour
night-market-food-tour.price_text: Guided tours vary; check on the day
night-market-food-tour.tip: Join a small-group tour to try satay, nasi goreng and sweets safely; confirm pickup and price.

ancol-beach.name: Ancol beach and waterfront
ancol-beach.price_text: Park entry fee; check on the day
ancol-beach.tip: A city beach for sunset views and seafood; water quality varies, so check before swimming.

thamrin-viewpoint.name: Thamrin skyline viewpoint
thamrin-viewpoint.price_text: Free on the street; rooftop bars charge for drinks
thamrin-viewpoint.hours: Best around sunset; bars open into the night
thamrin-viewpoint.tip: Walk the Thamrin area at dusk or take a rooftop bar seat for the skyline and Monas view.

stays.why: Central for the MRT, big malls and the National Monument; easy to reach most sights.
Cafés, restaurants and nightlife; quieter streets than the centre.
Next to Old Batavia (Kota Tua) and its museums; good for history-focused days.
Waterfront parks and family attractions; cooler breeze but far from the centre.

food: Try Jakarta staples: nasi goreng, sate ayam, gado-gado and kerak telor, an egg-and-rice street snack.
Eat at night markets and street warungs for cheap, fresh food; look for busy stalls with local queues.
Padang restaurants serve ready-made spicy dishes piled high; you pay for what you eat.
In malls, food courts are clean and cheap; sit-down restaurants cost more but are reliable.
Tap water is not safe to drink. Drink bottled or filtered water, and be careful with ice from street stalls.
more_time: Add a day trip to Bogor for the botanical gardens and cooler hills; check train times on the day.
History fans can spend a half day in Kota Tua: the old town square, museum and harbour area.
Families can swap a mall day for Ancol's waterfront parks and attractions.
